effects.printed_clause: 1 Tuner Synchro Monster + "Winged Bauy Fenrir"; must first be Synchro Summoned.
effects.lua_implementation: Revive limit plus Synchro procedure requires a Tuner that is also Synchro and exact non-Tuner passcode 237444604, permitting revival only after proper Synchro Summon.

official_references.matched_structure: Near-exact Tuner Synchro plus named/non-Tuner Synchro procedure and revive limit.

effects.printed_clause: Opponent cannot target other "Bau" cards on field with effects.
effects.lua_implementation: Field cannot-target effect covers own on-field Bau cards except this handler and uses opponent-only aux.tgoval.

official_references.matched_structure: Exact opponent-only protection for other archetype cards.

effects.printed_clause: If Special Summoned: banish 3 GY cards; return 1 field card to hand.
effects.lua_implementation: Optional summon trigger banishes exactly three Necrovalley-legal GY cards as cost and non-target-selects one returnable field card at resolution.

official_references.matched_structure: Mass/selected field return-to-hand operation after a cost.

effects.printed_clause: Return this card from GY/banishment to Extra Deck; add a "Bau" from GY/banishment.
effects.lua_implementation: Ignition sends self to Extra Deck as cost with Necrovalley check when in GY, then selects a face-up-accessible archetype card from GY/banishment and adds it.

coverage_override.reason: The named Synchro material requirement plus first-Synchro-Summon condition form one procedure unit. Other-Bau targeting protection, the Special-Summon banish-three/return effect, and the GY/banishment Extra-Deck return/recovery effect are the other three units.
